description: MainActivity class for Android TV Ping Pong game. Handles UI initialization, input events (DPAD, buttons), game state management, and navigation to Settings.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity that serves as the entry point for the Ping Pong game, manages UI and user input, and navigation to settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, binds game view, sets up event handlers, and displays initial UI text.

methods.name: togglePause
methods.description: Toggles pause state of the game.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Pauses the game and launches the Settings activity.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Loads game settings and resumes game when activity comes to foreground.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses game when activity goes to background.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles DPAD and menu key events for game control and navigation.
